integrity: Explicit all-integer proof with two independently implemented finite corroboration programs; finite computations are not the proof. No independent expert validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two equal-size Černý factors with opposite letter labels under a common input word; does not cover arbitrary synchronizing automata, unequal sizes, or independently controlled inputs. Only the minimum length and a witness, not all optimal words, are classified. Undiscovered prior equivalent work remains possible.
title: Exact crossed-alphabet synchronization threshold for two Černý automata
